name: Myntra
shortInfo: Sellers can access all of their Myntra order data using this connector.
brief: Myntra is your one stop shop for all your fashion & lifestyle needs. It is India's largest e-commerce store for fashion and lifestyle products.
about:
Get access to Seller Order data through this Myntra connector. It automatically streams relevant Myntra data into a user-determined data warehouse once you configure the relevant pipelines.

Check more about api documentation [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/myntra/index.html).
availableData:
[Seller Orders](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/myntra/pipelines/seller-orders.html)

[](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/myntra/pipelines/seller-orders.html)This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the details of orders in your Myntra Seller Account.
